node.title: XR rank-two rows have an exact dual support-extension factorization
node.statement: For a rank-two row on active union X with support S_i, active zero set Z_i=X\S_i, and selected-block extension T_i=A_i\S_i, the active-union and block dual-GRS numerators have one unique common cofactor: F_i=R_i Lambda_Zi and P_i=R_i Lambda_Ti. Exactly |T_i|=h-d-1+|Z_i| and deg R_i<=d-|Z_i|, while the row on S_i is R_i/Lambda'_Si. The converse is exact at the dual-codeword level. Actual agreement-block realization, extension counting, first-core ownership, and aggregate payment remain open.
